title: On a measure-theoretic reading of $β$-Grüss-type inequalities
summary: On its absolute-integrability domain, the positive $β$-integral is integration with respect to a finite positive purely atomic measure. After normalisation, its Chebyshev functional is a covariance, and its $L^p$-spaces are canonically isometric to direct sums of weighted sequence spaces. On the natural product- and square-integrability domains, the previously formulated $β$-Grüss inequalities reduce to Korkine's identity, Hölder's inequality, Cauchy-Schwarz, and elementary variance bounds.
